name: Internet Connection
description: Troubleshoot common Wi-Fi, Ethernet, router, and connectivity problems.

check_scope.question: Can any other devices connect to the internet?
check_scope.help_text: Try another phone, computer, or tablet using the same network.

test_other_device.title: Test Another Device
test_other_device.instruction: Try connecting another phone, computer, or tablet to the same network.

confirm_scope_after_test.question: Can any other devices connect to the internet?
confirm_scope_after_test.help_text: Use the result from testing another device. If the result still cannot be determined, choose I'm Not Sure to end this repeated check safely.

scope_unresolved.title: Network Scope Could Not Be Confirmed
scope_unresolved.message: Another-device testing did not provide a clear result. Record which device and network were tested, any visible connection status or error, and ask an authorized support contact to review the network scope before making further changes.

check_connection.question: How does this computer connect to the internet?

identify_connection.title: Identify the Connection
identify_connection.instruction: Look near the clock for a Wi-Fi symbol or check whether a network cable is connected to the computer.

show_wifi_help.title: Check Wi-Fi Status
show_wifi_help.instruction: Select the network icon near the clock and confirm that Wi-Fi is turned on.

enable_wifi.title: Turn On Wi-Fi
enable_wifi.instruction: Select the network icon near the clock, turn on Wi-Fi, and try connecting again.

reconnect_wifi.title: Reconnect to Wi-Fi
reconnect_wifi.instruction: Disconnect from the wireless network, reconnect, and enter the network password if requested.

check_ethernet_cable.title: Check the Ethernet Cable
check_ethernet_cable.instruction: Confirm that the network cable is firmly connected to both the computer and the router or wall connection.

restart_network_equipment.title: Restart the Network Equipment
restart_network_equipment.instruction: If this is equipment you own or are authorized to restart, save any active work that depends on the connection. Unplug the router and separate modem from power for at least 30 seconds. Reconnect the modem first and wait for its status lights to stabilize, then reconnect the router. Do not restart workplace, shared-building, cellular, or provider-managed equipment without approval.

verify_resolution.question: Can this computer connect to the internet now?

resolved.title: Internet Connection Restored
resolved.message: The connection appears to be working again.

advanced_diagnostics.title: Continue to Advanced Network Diagnostics
advanced_diagnostics.message: The basic checks did not restore the connection. Continue with IP address, gateway, internet reachability, and DNS diagnostics.
